unitTitle: See New Places, Meet New Faces

sections.title: Reading — Los Angeles, The City of Angels

exercises.instructionEn: Los Angeles — The City of Angels
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLANING TO'LIQ MATNI:

  LOS ANGELES — THE CITY OF ANGELS

  Los Angeles is THE SECOND LARGEST city in America.
  It's also home to film stars, SUNNY weather, TALL
  buildings and HEAVY traffic.

  ACCOMMODATION
  The hotels in LA are MORE EXPENSIVE than those in many
  other American cities, but they are CLEAN and safe.
  The Biltmore and The Omni are lovely, and close to
  special bus-stops where you can get CHEAP rides to the
  various sights.

  PLACES TO VISIT
  There are many INTERESTING places you can visit, like
  Venice Beach with its street performers, Universal
  Studios to see how they make films, and Griffith Park.
  You can also see the handprints and footprints of film
  stars outside Grauman's Chinese Theatre. Children can
  visit the Children's Museum — one of THE MOST EXCITING
  museums in the world.

  EATING OUT
  There are FAMOUS restaurants you can eat at, like the
  Buffalo Club, a place packed with celebrities, or
  Musso & Frank's, Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant. For
  THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes, eat at the Border
  Grill.

  SHOPPING
  You can buy CHEAP FASHIONABLE clothes on Melrose
  Avenue. Do you want designer clothes? Then go to the
  EXPENSIVE shops on Rodeo Drive. A visit there is always
  UNFORGETTABLE.

  ENTERTAINMENT
  The nightlife is EXCITING on the Sunset Strip, an area
  in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and
  The Roxy. There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music.
  24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear are popular with
  visitors.

  LA is a MODERN city with something for everyone. It's
  NOISY AND CROWDED, but it's also FASCINATING.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:

  LOS-ANJELES — FARIShTALAR ShAHRI

  Los-Anjeles Amerikadagi ikkinchi eng katta shahar.
  U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo,
  baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.

  TURAR JOY
  LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika
  shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq, lekin ular toza va
  xavfsiz. 'Biltmore' va 'Omni' — ajoyib, va siz
  diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borishingiz
  mumkin bo'lgan maxsus avtobus bekatlariga yaqin.

  BORISh KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR
  Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar
  bor: ko'cha artistlari bilan Venis-Bich, filmlarni
  qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rish uchun 'Universal
  Studios' va Griffit parki. Shuningdek Grauman Xitoy
  teatri oldida kino yulduzlarining qo'l va oyoq
  izlarini ko'rishingiz mumkin. Bolalar Bolalar
  muzeyiga borishlari mumkin — bu dunyodagi eng
  qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.

  TAShQARIDA OVQATLANISh
  Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar
  bor: masalan, mashhur odamlar to'lib ketgan 'Buffalo
  Club' yoki Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran 'Musso &
  Frank's'. Eng mazali meksika taomlari uchun 'Border
  Grill' ga boring.

  XARID QILISh
  Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib
  olishingiz mumkin. Dizayner kiyimlar xohlaysizmi?
  Unda Rodeo-Drayvdagi qimmat do'konlarga boring.
  U yerga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.

  KO'NGILOChAR
  Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur
  klublar joylashgan Sanset-Strip hududida tungi hayot
  juda qiziqarli. U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan
  zavqlanishingiz mumkin. 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat
  ishlaydigan kafelar sayyohlar orasida mashhur.

  LA — har kim uchun biror narsasi bor zamonaviy shahar.
  U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.


SARLAVHANING MA'NOSI:
  'Los Angeles' ispanchada 'Farishtalar' degani
  ('los angeles' = the angels).
  Shuning uchun shaharning laqabi —
  'The City of Angels' (Farishtalar shahri).


MAQOLADAGI QIYOSIY VA ORTTIRMA DARAJALAR
(Unit 12 ning grammatikasi — MATNDAN toping):

  QIYOSIY (-er / more ... than):
     more expensive than

  ORTTIRMA (the ...-est / the most ...):
     THE SECOND LARGEST city
     one of THE MOST EXCITING museums
     Hollywood's OLDEST restaurant
     THE MOST DELICIOUS Mexican dishes

  DIQQAT: orttirma daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.
  'the largest', 'the oldest', 'the most exciting'.
  Bu — 84-betda batafsil o'rganiladi.


MAQOLADAGI ATOQLI OTLAR:
  The Biltmore, The Omni  — mehmonxonalar
  Venice Beach            — plyaj (ko'cha artistlari)
  Universal Studios       — kinostudiya
  Griffith Park           — park
  Grauman's Chinese Theatre — kinoteatr (yulduzlar izlari)
  Children's Museum       — Bolalar muzeyi
  Buffalo Club, Musso & Frank's, Border Grill — restoranlar
  Melrose Avenue, Rodeo Drive — savdo ko'chalari
  Sunset Strip            — ko'ngilochar hudud
  The Whiskey, The Roxy   — klublar
  Van Go's Ear            — 24 soatlik kafe


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  accommodation = turar joy
  a sight       = diqqatga sazovor joy
  various       = turli xil
  a ride        = yo'l, sayohat (transportda)
  a performer   = artist, ijrochi
  a handprint   = qo'l izi
  a footprint   = oyoq izi
  packed with   = ... bilan to'lib ketgan
  a celebrity   = mashhur odam
  delicious     = mazali
  designer clothes = dizayner kiyimlar
  unforgettable = unutilmas
  entertainment = ko'ngilochar
  fascinating   = maftunkor
  heavy traffic = zich transport oqimi

points.en: Los Angeles is the second largest city in America.
points.uz: Los-Anjeles Amerikadagi ikkinchi eng katta shahar.
points.noteUz:
ORTTIRMA daraja: 'the ... LARGEST'.
'the second largest' = ikkinchi eng katta.

points.en: It's also home to film stars, sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic.
points.uz: U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo, baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.
points.noteUz:
'be home to' = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq.
'heavy traffic' = zich transport oqimi.

points.en: ACCOMMODATION — The hotels in LA are more expensive than those in many other American cities, but they are clean and safe.
points.uz: TURAR JOY — LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq, lekin ular toza va xavfsiz.
points.noteUz:
QIYOSIY daraja: 'MORE expensive THAN'.
'those' = 'the hotels' o'rniga.

points.en: The Biltmore and The Omni are lovely, and close to special bus-stops where you can get cheap rides to the various sights.
points.uz: 'Biltmore' va 'Omni' ajoyib, va diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borish mumkin bo'lgan maxsus bekatlarga yaqin.
points.noteUz:
'close to' = ... ga yaqin.
'a sight' = diqqatga sazovor joy.

points.en: PLACES TO VISIT — There are many interesting places you can visit, like Venice Beach with its street performers, Universal Studios to see how they make films, and Griffith Park.
points.uz: BORISH KERAK BO'LGAN JOYLAR — Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar bor: ko'cha artistlari bilan Venis-Bich, filmlarni qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rish uchun 'Universal Studios' va Griffit parki.
points.noteUz:
'like' bu yerda 'masalan' ma'nosida.
'a street performer' = ko'cha artisti (E rasmi).

points.en: You can also see the handprints and footprints of film stars outside Grauman's Chinese Theatre.
points.uz: Shuningdek Grauman Xitoy teatri oldida kino yulduzlarining qo'l va oyoq izlarini ko'rishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz:
'a handprint' = qo'l izi (D rasmi).
'outside' = tashqarisida, oldida.

points.en: Children can visit the Children's Museum — one of the most exciting museums in the world.
points.uz: Bolalar Bolalar muzeyiga borishlari mumkin — bu dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.
points.noteUz:
ORTTIRMA: 'one of THE MOST EXCITING museums'.
'one of the ...' dan keyin KO'PLIK ot (A rasmi).

points.en: EATING OUT — There are famous restaurants you can eat at, like the Buffalo Club, a place packed with celebrities, or Musso & Frank's, Hollywood's oldest restaurant.
points.uz: TASHQARIDA OVQATLANISH — Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar bor: mashhur odamlar to'lib ketgan 'Buffalo Club' yoki Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran 'Musso & Frank's'.
points.noteUz:
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 3-bandi shu gapdan.
'packed with' = to'lib ketgan.
ORTTIRMA: 'OLDEST restaurant'.

points.en: For the most delicious Mexican dishes, eat at the Border Grill.
points.uz: Eng mazali meksika taomlari uchun 'Border Grill' ga boring.
points.noteUz:
ORTTIRMA: 'THE MOST DELICIOUS'.
'a dish' = taom (B rasmi).

points.en: SHOPPING — You can buy cheap fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue.
points.uz: XARID QILISH — Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olishingiz mumkin.
points.noteUz: 82-betdagi 3-mashqning 4-bandi shu gapdan.

points.en: Do you want designer clothes? Then go to the expensive shops on Rodeo Drive. A visit there is always unforgettable.
points.uz: Dizayner kiyimlar xohlaysizmi? Unda Rodeo-Drayvdagi qimmat do'konlarga boring. U yerga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.
points.noteUz:
'designer clothes' = dizayner kiyimlar (C rasmi).
'unforgettable' = un + forget + able = unutilmas.

points.en: ENTERTAINMENT — The nightlife is exciting on the Sunset Strip, an area in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and The Roxy.
points.uz: KO'NGILOCHAR — Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur klublar joylashgan Sanset-Strip hududida tungi hayot juda qiziqarli.
points.noteUz:
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 5-bandi shu gapdan.
'an area' = hudud (F rasmi).

points.en: There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music. 24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear are popular with visitors.
points.uz: U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan zavqlanishingiz mumkin. 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat ishlaydigan kafelar sayyohlar orasida mashhur.
points.noteUz:
'rock 'n' roll' = 'rock AND roll' ning qisqargani.
'popular WITH' — predlog WITH.

points.en: LA is a modern city with something for everyone. It's noisy and crowded, but it's also fascinating.
points.uz: LA — har kim uchun biror narsasi bor zamonaviy shahar. U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.
points.noteUz:
82-betdagi 3-mashqning 6-bandi shu gapdan.
'fascinating' = maftunkor.
Maqolaning XULOSASI — ijobiy nota bilan tugaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures on this page. Which shows: heavy traffic; a museum; a street performer; handprints of film stars; a Mexican dish; designer clothes; a club?
exercises.instructionUz: Shu betdagi rasmlarga qarang. Qaysi biri quyidagilarni ko'rsatadi: zich transport oqimi; muzey; ko'cha artisti; kino yulduzlarining qo'l izlari; meksika taomi; dizayner kiyimlar; klub?
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI RASM — A, B, C, D, E, F, G.

RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

  A — oldida 'LOS ANGELES CHILDREN'S MUSEUM' deb
      yozilgan zamonaviy bino
      →  A MUSEUM (muzey)

  B — likopchada meksika taomi: taco, sabzavot, sous
      →  A MEXICAN DISH (meksika taomi)

  C — podiumda oq kostyumdagi uch manekenshi
      →  DESIGNER CLOTHES (dizayner kiyimlar)

  D — sementdagi qo'l izlari, qizil gilam va to'siq;
      odamlar tomosha qilyapti
      →  HANDPRINTS OF FILM STARS
         (kino yulduzlarining qo'l izlari)

  E — yuzi bo'yalgan, rang-barang kostyumdagi odam
      baraban chalyapti; atrofda olomon
      →  A STREET PERFORMER (ko'cha artisti)

  F — qorong'i ichki xona, rang-barang yorug'lik,
      odamlar
      →  A CLUB (klub)

  G — shosseda tirbandlikda turgan yuzlab mashinalar
      →  HEAVY TRAFFIC (zich transport oqimi)


JAVOBLAR RO'YXATI:
  heavy traffic            →  G
  a museum                 →  A
  a street performer       →  E
  handprints of film stars →  D
  a Mexican dish           →  B
  designer clothes         →  C
  a club                   →  F


HAR BIRI MAQOLANING QAYSI BO'LIMIGA TEGIShLI:
  A (muzey)        →  PLACES TO VISIT
  B (taom)         →  EATING OUT
  C (kiyim)        →  SHOPPING
  D (qo'l izlari)  →  PLACES TO VISIT
  E (artist)       →  PLACES TO VISIT (Venice Beach)
  F (klub)         →  ENTERTAINMENT
  G (tirbandlik)   →  sarlavha ostidagi kirish
                       ('heavy traffic')

pairs.leftUz: 'LOS ANGELES CHILDREN'S MUSEUM' yozuvi bilan zamonaviy bino
pairs.whyUz:
Binoning oldida ANIQ yozuv bor.
Maqola: 'Children can visit the Children's Museum —
one of the most exciting museums in the world.'

Taco — Meksika taomi.
Maqola: 'For the most delicious Mexican dishes,
eat at the Border Grill.'

Podium va manekenshilar → moda namoyishi.
Maqola: 'Do you want designer clothes? Then go to
the expensive shops on Rodeo Drive.'

pairs.leftUz: Sementdagi qo'l izlari, qizil gilam va to'siq
pairs.whyUz:
Maqola: 'You can also see the handprints and
footprints of film stars outside Grauman's Chinese
Theatre.'
Qizil gilam va to'siq — muhim joy ekanini ko'rsatadi.

pairs.leftUz: Yuzi bo'yalgan, rang-barang kostyumdagi baraban chaluvchi; atrofda olomon
pairs.whyUz:
Ko'chada, olomon oldida chiqish qilyapti.
Maqola: 'Venice Beach with its street performers'.

Qorong'ilik va sahna yorug'ligi → tungi klub.
Maqola: 'famous clubs like The Whiskey and The Roxy'.

Maqolaning kirish qismi: 'It's also home to film
stars, sunny weather, tall buildings and HEAVY
TRAFFIC.'
LA — tirbandligi bilan mashhur.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the article and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolani o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh SAVOL — har biri maqolaning BITTA bo'limiga
to'g'ri keladi:

  1-savol  →  ACCOMMODATION
  2-savol  →  PLACES TO VISIT
  3-savol  →  EATING OUT
  4-savol  →  SHOPPING
  5-savol  →  ENTERTAINMENT

Har bir savol IKKI qismdan iborat:
  • QAYERDA? (joy nomi)
  • NIMA maxsus / NIMA qilish mumkin?

Shuning uchun javob ham IKKI qismli bo'lishi kerak.

points.en: 1  Where can you stay in LA? What is special about these places?
points.uz: 1  LA da qayerda turishingiz mumkin? Bu joylarning nimasi maxsus?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — ACCOMMODATION bo'limidan.

points.en: You can stay at The Biltmore or The Omni. They are lovely, clean and safe, and they are close to special bus-stops where you can get cheap rides to the various sights. Hotels in LA are more expensive than those in many other American cities.
points.uz: 'Biltmore' yoki 'Omni' da turishingiz mumkin. Ular ajoyib, toza va xavfsiz, hamda diqqatga sazovor joylarga arzon yetib borish mumkin bo'lgan maxsus avtobus bekatlariga yaqin. LA dagi mehmonxonalar boshqa ko'p Amerika shaharlaridagilardan qimmatroq.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
'to stay AT a hotel' — predlog AT.
MAXSUS TOMONI: bekatlarga yaqin → arzon yetib
borish mumkin. Bu narxi qimmatligini qoplaydi.

points.en: 2  Which places can you visit? What can you see there?
points.uz: 2  Qaysi joylarga borishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima ko'rasiz?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — PLACES TO VISIT bo'limidan.

points.en: You can visit Venice Beach, where you can see street performers; Universal Studios, where you can see how they make films; Griffith Park; Grauman's Chinese Theatre, where you can see the handprints and footprints of film stars; and the Children's Museum, one of the most exciting museums in the world.
points.uz: Venis-Bichga borishingiz mumkin — u yerda ko'cha artistlarini ko'rasiz; 'Universal Studios' ga — filmlarni qanday suratga olishlarini ko'rasiz; Griffit parkiga; Grauman Xitoy teatriga — kino yulduzlarining qo'l va oyoq izlarini ko'rasiz; va Bolalar muzeyiga — dunyodagi eng qiziqarli muzeylardan biri.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
BESh joy sanalgan.
DIQQAT: Griffith Park uchun maqola nima ko'rish
mumkinligini AYTMAYDI — faqat nomini beradi.

points.en: 3  Where can you eat? What is special about each place?
points.uz: 3  Qayerda ovqatlanishingiz mumkin? Har bir joyning nimasi maxsus?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — EATING OUT bo'limidan.

points.en: You can eat at the Buffalo Club, which is packed with celebrities; at Musso & Frank's, which is Hollywood's oldest restaurant; or at the Border Grill, which has the most delicious Mexican dishes.
points.uz: 'Buffalo Club' da ovqatlanishingiz mumkin — u mashhur odamlar bilan to'lib ketgan; 'Musso & Frank's' da — u Gollivuddagi eng eski restoran; yoki 'Border Grill' da — u yerda eng mazali meksika taomlari bor.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
UCh restoran, har birining O'Z maxsus tomoni bor:
  Buffalo Club    → mashhur odamlar
  Musso & Frank's → eng eski
  Border Grill    → eng mazali meksika taomlari

points.en: 4  Where can you go shopping? What can you buy there?
points.uz: 4  Qayerda xarid qilishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima sotib olasiz?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — SHOPPING bo'limidan.

points.en: You can go shopping on Melrose Avenue, where you can buy cheap fashionable clothes, or on Rodeo Drive, where there are expensive shops selling designer clothes. A visit to Rodeo Drive is always unforgettable.
points.uz: Melrouz avenyusida xarid qilishingiz mumkin — u yerda arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olasiz; yoki Rodeo-Drayvda — u yerda dizayner kiyimlar sotadigan qimmat do'konlar bor. Rodeo-Drayvga tashrif doim unutilmasdir.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
IKKI ko'cha — QARAMA-QARShI:
  Melrose Avenue → ARZON, moda kiyimlar
  Rodeo Drive    → QIMMAT, dizayner kiyimlar
'go shopping ON ... Avenue' — ko'cha bilan ON.

points.en: 5  Where can you go in the evening? What can you do there?
points.uz: 5  Kechqurun qayerga borishingiz mumkin? U yerda nima qilishingiz mumkin?
points.noteUz: SAVOL — ENTERTAINMENT bo'limidan.

points.en: You can go to the Sunset Strip, an area in Hollywood with famous clubs like The Whiskey and The Roxy. There you can enjoy rock 'n' roll music. You can also go to 24-hour cafes like Van Go's Ear, which are popular with visitors.
points.uz: Sanset-Stripga borishingiz mumkin — bu Gollivuddagi 'The Whiskey' va 'The Roxy' kabi mashhur klublar joylashgan hudud. U yerda rok-n-roll musiqasidan zavqlanishingiz mumkin. Shuningdek 'Van Go's Ear' kabi 24 soat ishlaydigan kafelarga ham borishingiz mumkin — ular sayyohlar orasida mashhur.
points.noteUz:
JAVOB.
'in the evening' = kechqurun.
IKKI xil joy: KLUBLAR (musiqa) va
24 SOATLIK KAFELAR (sayyohlar uchun).

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the article's sub-headings with the ones in the list: Nightlife - Restaurants - Shops - Hotels - Sights
exercises.instructionUz: Maqolaning kichik sarlavhalarini ro'yxatdagilar bilan almashtiring: Nightlife - Restaurants - Shops - Hotels - Sights
exercises.explanationUz:
MAQOLADAGI BESh KIChIK SARLAVHA:
  ACCOMMODATION, PLACES TO VISIT, EATING OUT,
  SHOPPING, ENTERTAINMENT

RO'YXATDAGI BESh YANGI SARLAVHA:
  Nightlife, Restaurants, Shops, Hotels, Sights


ALMAShTIRISh:

  ACCOMMODATION   →  HOTELS
     (turar joy → mehmonxonalar)
     Bo'limda faqat mehmonxonalar haqida gap boradi.

  PLACES TO VISIT →  SIGHTS
     (borish kerak bo'lgan joylar → diqqatga sazovor
      joylar)
     'a sight' aynan shu ma'noni beradi.
     DIQQAT: bo'limning o'zida ham 'the various
     SIGHTS' so'zi bor.

  EATING OUT      →  RESTAURANTS
     (tashqarida ovqatlanish → restoranlar)
     Bo'limda uchta restoran sanalgan.

  SHOPPING        →  SHOPS
     (xarid qilish → do'konlar)
     Eng oson juftlik — bir o'zakdan.

  ENTERTAINMENT   →  NIGHTLIFE
     (ko'ngilochar → tungi hayot)
     Bo'limning birinchi so'zi ham 'The NIGHTLIFE'.


NIMANI O'RGATADI:
  Bir xil mazmunni turli sarlavhalar bilan berish
  mumkin. Eski sarlavhalar HARAKATNI bildiradi
  (shopping, eating out — -ing shakli),
  yangilari esa NARSANI bildiradi
  (shops, restaurants — ot).


DIQQAT — 'SIGHT' SO'ZI:
  a sight = diqqatga sazovor joy
  sightseeing = shahar tomosha qilish
  Bu — 'to see' fe'lidan yasalgan.

pairs.whyUz:
Bo'limda faqat mehmonxonalar haqida:
The Biltmore, The Omni.
'accommodation' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot,
'hotels' esa sanaladi.

'a sight' = diqqatga sazovor joy.
DIQQAT: ACCOMMODATION bo'limining o'zida ham
'the various SIGHTS' iborasi ishlatilgan —
kitob shu so'zni ataylab oldindan bergan.

Bo'limda UCh restoran: Buffalo Club,
Musso & Frank's, Border Grill.
'eat out' = uyda emas, tashqarida ovqatlanmoq.

Bir o'zakdan: shop (do'kon) → shopping (xarid qilish).
Bo'limda Melrose Avenue va Rodeo Drive do'konlari.

Bo'limning BIRINChI so'zi ham 'The NIGHTLIFE is
exciting on the Sunset Strip'.
Klublar, musiqa, tungi kafelar — hammasi
kechqurungi hayot.

patterns.formula: There are + sifat + KO'PLIK ot + you can + fe'l ( + predlog).
patterns.exampleEn: There are many interesting places you can visit. There are famous restaurants you can eat at.
patterns.exampleUz: Borishingiz mumkin bo'lgan ko'plab qiziqarli joylar bor. Ovqatlanishingiz mumkin bo'lgan mashhur restoranlar bor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Sayohat maqolalarining asosiy qolipi.
Predlog ('at') gap OXIRIDA qoladi.

patterns.exampleEn: You can buy cheap fashionable clothes on Melrose Avenue, like designer clothes on Rodeo Drive.
patterns.exampleUz: Melrouz avenyusida arzon, moda kiyimlar sotib olishingiz mumkin.

patterns.formula: one of THE MOST + sifat + KO'PLIK ot

patterns.explanationUz:
'one of the ...' dan keyin DOIM KO'PLIK ot.
ORTTIRMA daraja 'THE' bilan keladi.

patterns.formula: X is + sifat, BUT it's also + sifat.
patterns.exampleEn: It's noisy and crowded, but it's also fascinating.
patterns.exampleUz: U shovqinli va gavjum, lekin ayni paytda maftunkor.
patterns.explanationUz:
Maqolani XULOSA bilan tugatish qolipi:
kamchilikni aytib, keyin ijobiy nota bilan yakunlash.

patterns.exampleEn: It's also home to film stars, sunny weather, tall buildings and heavy traffic.
patterns.exampleUz: U shuningdek kino yulduzlari, quyoshli ob-havo, baland binolar va zich transport oqimining makoni.
patterns.explanationUz:
'be home TO' = ... ning makoni bo'lmoq.
Shahar yoki mamlakat tasvirlashda ishlatiladi.
